recycled_content.source_quote: PLA (including ReFill) … PLA (Polylactic Acid) biopolymer … 50% recycled PLA polymer … by weight (post-industrial); … remaining 50% virgin PLA
recycled_content.notes: Self-declared under ISO 14021 (Type II), dated 16 March 2026; footnote: based on the average of all colours as of declaration date. The rPLA category page says 'up to 50% recycled material', so individual colours may be lower. Sustainability Profile (July 2025) also states 'Recycled content: 50% (percentage by weight; based on supplier material declarations)'.
